name: viesvatchecker
description: Telegram bot for monitoring VAT number availability in VIES.

scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && bun test docker
scripts.format: biome format --write apps packages docker package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format apps packages docker package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml biome.json
scripts.lint: biome lint apps packages docker package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml biome.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write apps packages docker package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml biome.json
